module: Default checkpoint marker of scenario_race_marker: two columns (model single_faded_column.dae) on either side of the passage, plus a ground base (checkpoint_curve_base.dae). The columns grow with distance to stay visible from afar. Supports split screen: each marker can be visible to only one player (setRenderViewPlayer). The module returns a constructor: require('scenario/raceMarkers/sideColumnMarker')(id) gives an object of class C.
notes: Colors per mode: default red (1, 0.07, 0), next black, start and lap green (0.4, 1, 0.2), recovery yellow (1, 0.85, 0), final blue (0.1, 0.3, 1), branch orange (1, 0.6, 0), hidden black. 0.3 s color fade.
setToCheckpoint(wp) reads wp.pos, wp.radius (half the gap between the columns), wp.normal (passage direction, optional), wp.fadeNear (1 by default), wp.fadeFar (50), wp.minAlpha (0.25).
The columns are placed at pos +/- side*radius with a vertical offset of -10 m, and their height grows with distance (up to about 20 units between 60 and 180 m, then more at long distances).
The reference camera for the distance is the one of the renderViewPlayer player's context (core_camera.getContextIdForPlayer), otherwise the main camera.
The objects are stored by identifiers (baseId, leftId, rightId) and looked up every frame with scenetree.findObjectById.
The extracted page shows update(dtSim); the actual signature is update(dt, dtSim).

init.desc: Constructor: initializes the state and calls clearMarkers.

update.desc: Per-frame call: computes color, alpha, size of the base and columns from the distance to the camera.

setToCheckpoint.desc: Places base and columns on a checkpoint.

setMode.desc: Changes mode: shows (except 'hidden') and starts the color fade.

mode.desc: default, next, start, lap, recovery, final, branch or hidden.

setVisibility.desc: Shows or hides base and columns.

applyRenderViewMask.desc: Clears the objects' render masks then hides them in the split-screen views of players other than renderViewPlayer (render_splitScreen.getPlayers).

setRenderViewPlayer.desc: Reserves this marker for one player's view (nil for all) and applies the mask.

createObject.desc: Creates a hidden TSStatic registered under objectName and added to ScenarioObjectsGroup.

createMarkers.desc: Removes the old objects then creates the base and the two columns, and applies the view mask.

clearMarker.desc: Removes an object from its identifier (render mask cleared before removal).
